name: Ritual circle
description: A round patch of dark crypt flagstones about 3.5 m across and a few centimetres high, ringed by curved kerb stones, with a dark red-brown sigil painted over it: two concentric rings with rune marks between them, a five-pointed star with a small ring at each point, and a dark disc at the centre.
